messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up + evidence request

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. ACME Security has started the SIG review and the questionnaire itself is nearly complete, but the reviewers need an evidence package to close a few controls (network diagrams, privileged access screenshots, retention policy copy, and a short runbook for incident notification).

Can you provide a single "evidence binder" (PDF preferred) or a Drive folder that contains:
- Current network architecture diagram showing VPC boundaries and peering
- ACL/security group examples where applicable
- Access control policy (IAM + KMS key custodians)
- Screenshot of KMS audit logs showing rotation activity (can be redacted)
- Short runbook (1-2 pages) describing how we escalate and notify on suspected data exfiltration

Our target is to complete the SIG review by 2026-11-30. Procurement (cc: Alex) has asked for the evidence to attach to the contract folder. Let me know if you need an NDA or a signed MSA to share anything beyond public pages.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Senior InfoSec Analyst — ACME Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmehealth.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up + evidence request

Hi Lina / Alex —

Thanks — we can assemble an evidence binder and share a Drive folder with the requested artifacts. I want to confirm scope before we produce anything: is the request scoped to the SIG controls in the questionnaire (i.e., infrastructure and operational controls) or do you need application-level screenshots as well? For most of these items we can provide redacted screenshots and policies; raw logs would require a secured share and a brief DPA/NDAs are acceptable if needed.

Planned deliverables (target by 2026-11-20):
- redwood-sig-evidence-binder.pdf (compiled artifacts + index)
- network-architecture-v2.png (annotated)
- access-control-policy-2026.pdf (active policy extract)
- kms-log-screenshot.png (rotated keys audit view, redacted)
- incident-notification-runbook.pdf (2 pages, owner contacts)

If that works, I'll loop in the internal team to gather screenshots and diagrams. If you need the binder earlier or in a different format (ZIP) let me know.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference

Let me know if you need more time. I told the customer a best-effort target of 11/20.

Soojin
